signed.scope: Groups A (138), B (34) and C (5, each as recommended) coded; group D (10) held uncoded; source rewritten to cite WHO.

codes.title: Acute arterial occlusion, unspecified
codes.note: Unspecified site. Lower limb is BD30.2, upper limb BD30.0.

codes.title: Acute or subacute hepatic failure, unspecified
Anxiety or fear-related disorders, unspecified
codes.note: The addendum's 6B00 (generalised anxiety disorder) is one disorder; the search's top hit 6E63 (secondary anxiety) is wrong. 6B0Z is the unspecified residual of the anxiety block.

codes.title: Aortic aneurysm or dissection, unspecified
codes.note: No 'dissection, unspecified' code: BD50.Z is 'aneurysm or dissection, unspecified'. Site codes (BD50.0/.1/.2) once imaged.

codes.title: Acute appendicitis without localised or generalised peritonitis
codes.note: WHO index maps 'acute appendicitis NOS' to 'without localised or generalised peritonitis'. DB10.0 has no 'unspecified' child.

codes.title: Pneumonitis due to inhalation of food or vomit

codes.display: Back pain with red flags, cause not yet known
codes.title: Spinal pain, unspecified
codes.note: WHO index: 'back pain NOS'. The red flags themselves are not codable. The search's primary query found nothing; this came from the synonym search.

codes.title: Bipolar type I disorder, unspecified
codes.note: WHO index maps 'Bipolar disorder NOS' to type I; 6A6Z is 'bipolar or related disorders, unspecified'.

codes.title: Other specified obstruction of large intestine
codes.note: WHO index maps 'unspecified intestinal obstruction' here, a large-intestine code. Small-bowel obstruction is DA91.Z.

codes.display: Chest pain, cause not yet known
codes.title: Chest pain, unspecified
Malignant neoplasms of large intestine, site and type unspecified

codes.display: Acute confusion, cause not yet known
codes.title: Disorientation
codes.note: WHO index maps 'mental confusion NOS' to Disorientation. If the picture is delirium, the Delirium term (6D70.Z) applies.

codes.title: COVID-19
codes.note: Parent category. Its children are RA01.0 'virus identified' and RA01.1 'virus not identified', with no 'unspecified'. The parent avoids asserting a test result; the alternative is to split the term the way TB and malaria are split in v1.0.

codes.title: Diabetic foot ulcer
codes.note: Codes the ulcer; a diabetic foot infection without an ulcer is not covered.

codes.title: Drug-induced or toxic liver disease, unspecified
Lower limb deep vein thrombosis
codes.note: WHO index maps 'deep vein thrombosis NOS' to lower limb; BD71 has no 'unspecified' child.

codes.title: Infectious gastroenteritis or colitis without specification of infectious agent
codes.note: WHO index: 'dysentery' NOS. Search's top hit 1A02 (Shigella) rejected: the synonyms include amoebic dysentery (1A36.00).

codes.title: Unspecified disorders of lipoprotein metabolism or lipidaemias
Ectopic pregnancy, unspecified
codes.note: Code is clean. Separately, ADR 0182 flags that this term is 'standard', not restricted.

codes.title: Neutropaenia, unspecified
codes.note: ICD-11 has no febrile neutropenia concept; this codes the neutropenia, and the fever is lost. Search's top hit (a neonatal code) rejected.

codes.display: Gastrointestinal bleeding, source not yet known
codes.title: Gastrointestinal bleeding, unspecified
Heart failure, unspecified
codes.note: WHO's exact match is the cluster BD1Z&XT5R 'Acute heart failure'; stem only.

codes.title: HIV disease clinical stage 1 without mention of tuberculosis or malaria
codes.note: WHO index 'acute HIV infection syndrome' maps to stage 1, 'without mention of TB or malaria'.

codes.title: Intestinal helminthiasis, unspecified
codes.note: Search's top hit 1F90.0 'Mixed intestinal helminthiases' rejected. Hookworm alone is 1F68.Z.

codes.title: Hypothermia, not associated with low environmental temperature
codes.note: Alternative NF02 'Hypothermia', WHO's index target for plain 'hypothermia'; it sits in the injury chapter (environmental cause) and is already the code for 'Accidental hypothermia'. MG28 keeps this symptom-level term in the symptoms chapter, but its title asserts a non-environmental cause.

codes.title: Influenza, virus not identified
codes.note: WHO index 'flu' goes to 'virus not identified'; identified viruses are 1E30/1E31.

codes.title: Respiratory diseases principally affecting the lung interstitium, unspecified
Kaposi sarcoma of unspecified primary site
Abscess of liver
codes.note: Excludes amoebic liver abscess (1A36.10).

codes.title: Malignant neoplasms of bronchus or lung, unspecified
Lymphatic filariasis, unspecified
codes.note: Aetiology code (what the NTD programme counts). The search's top hit BD93.13 is the lymphoedema manifestation code.

codes.title: Harmful effects of or exposure to noxious substances, chiefly nonmedicinal as to source, not elsewhere classified
codes.note: WHO's exact match is the cluster NE61&XM7KD9 (methanol); stem only, shared with organophosphate.

codes.title: Necrotising fasciitis, unspecified
codes.note: WHO title is necrotising fasciitis; gas gangrene is separate (1C16).

codes.title: Nephritic syndrome
codes.note: WHO's exact match is the cluster GB40&XT5R 'Acute nephritic syndrome'; stem only.

codes.title: Cysticercosis of central nervous system, unspecified
Candidosis of gastrointestinal tract
codes.note: WHO's exact match is the cluster 1F23.2&XA0828 'Oesophageal candidosis'; stem only (GI tract candidosis).

codes.title: Harmful effects of drugs, medicaments or biological substances, not elsewhere classified
codes.note: Harmful effects of drugs NEC, which covers both halves. Search's top hit PC91 'Intentional self-harm…' rejected: it asserts intent. Stem only.

codes.title: Candidosis of lips or oral mucous membranes
Harmful effects of or exposure to noxious substances, chiefly nonmedicinal as to source, not elsewhere classified
codes.note: Stem only. ICD-11 puts the substance in an extension code (XM…) and the intent in an external-cause code; the column holds neither. It shares NE61 with methanol, so HMIS cannot tell them apart.

codes.title: Harmful effects of drugs, medicaments or biological substances, not elsewhere classified
codes.note: WHO index: 'paracetamol poisoning'. Search's top hit PC94 'Intentional self-harm…' rejected: it asserts intent. Stem only (substance extension not held).

codes.title: Parkinsonism, unspecified
codes.note: Parent 'Parkinsonism' covers both halves of the term; Parkinson disease alone is 8A00.0Z.

codes.title: Digestive system perforation of unspecified site
codes.note: WHO synonym 'gastrointestinal tract perforation NOS'. Search's top hit DC50.Z (peritonitis) rejected.

codes.title: Sequelae of tuberculosis
codes.note: Sequelae of tuberculosis (any site, not lung-specific). The search's primary query found nothing.

codes.display: Reduced consciousness, cause not yet known
codes.title: Disorders of consciousness, unspecified
Idiopathic rhabdomyolysis
codes.note: WHO index maps 'rhabdomyolysis NOS' to FB32.20 'Idiopathic rhabdomyolysis'. Alternative 8C84 'Secondary rhabdomyolysis', which fits most medical-ward causes (drugs, sepsis, trauma, heat, seizures).

codes.title: Acute rheumatic fever without mention of heart involvement, unspecified
codes.note: WHO title says 'without mention of heart involvement'; with carditis is 1B41.

codes.title: Subarachnoid haemorrhage not known if aneurysmal or non-aneurysmal

codes.display: Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis
codes.title: Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis
codes.note: WHO title is the term. When a drug caused it, EH63 is the drug-specific code.

codes.title: Traumatic subdural haemorrhage, unspecified whether acute or chronic
codes.note: WHO index maps 'subdural haematoma NOS' to traumatic. Alternative 8B02 'Nontraumatic subdural haemorrhage'. Many chronic subdurals follow a fall the patient does not recall.

codes.title: Psychotic disorder induced by unknown or unspecified psychoactive substance

codes.display: Syncope or collapse, cause not yet known
codes.title: Syncope or collapse, unspecified
Tuberculosis of other systems or organs
codes.note: Parent category (it has no 'unspecified' child). It covers lymph node, abdominal, bone, pericardial and other organ TB; it excludes CNS TB (own term, 1B11.0) and miliary TB (1B13). Search's top hit 1B12.6 (TB lymphadenopathy only) rejected as too narrow.

codes.title: Tuberculosis of heart
codes.note: WHO's exact match is the cluster 1B12.0&XA2XU0 'Tuberculosis of pericardium'; the column holds one code, so the stem (TB of heart) goes in.

codes.title: Tuberculosis of bones or joints
codes.note: No spine-specific code. WHO's index sends 'Pott's disease' to 8B4Y (a spinal cord disorder, i.e. the neurological complication), and the search's top hit 1B11.Y is TB of the nervous system. 1B12.40 codes the TB itself.

codes.title: African trypanosomiasis, unspecified
codes.note: Search's top hit 1F51.1Z (rhodesiense only) rejected: Uganda has both gambiense (north-west) and rhodesiense (south-east).

codes.title: Other specified diseases of the respiratory system
codes.note: WHO index 'Airway obstruction' sits in 'Other specified diseases of the respiratory system'. Search's top hit MD11.B 'Stridor' (the sign) rejected.

codes.title: Urolithiasis, unspecified
codes.note: Search's top hit GB70.0Z (kidney only) rejected: the term is any urinary tract stone.

codes.title: Oesophageal varices with bleeding
codes.note: Oesophageal varices only; gastric varices are DA43.0.

codes.display: Ventricular tachycardia or other malignant arrhythmia
codes.title: Ventricular tachyarrhythmia, unspecified
codes.note: 'Ventricular tachyarrhythmia, unspecified' covers VT and VF; 'other malignant arrhythmia' beyond ventricular is not covered.

codes.title: Acute vestibular syndrome, unspecified
codes.note: 'Acute vestibular syndrome, unspecified': the parent covers both neuritis (AB30.0) and labyrinthitis (AB30.1).

codes.title: Viral haemorrhagic fever, not elsewhere classified
codes.note: WHO synonym 'Viral haemorrhagic fever, not otherwise specified'. The term is 'suspected': coding it counts suspects as VHF (IDSR reports suspects anyway). Alternative: hold uncoded. Search's top hit 1D60.02 (Sudan virus disease) rejected as too specific.

codes.display: Weight loss, cause not yet known
codes.title: Excessive weight loss

held.reason: WHO's index maps 'angioedema NOS' to two codes (EB04 idiopathic, EB01.Z inducible), and the term's own synonym, ACE-inhibitor angioedema, is a third (EH61.1).

held.display: Malignancy suspected, primary not yet known
held.reason: 'Suspected'. 2D4Z / 2D44 would record a confirmed cancer of unknown primary and count it; a suspicion is not a diagnosis.

held.display: Spinal cord or cauda equina compression
held.reason: Cord compression is 8B42 'Myelopathy' (WHO synonym 'spinal cord compression'); cauda equina syndrome is 8B40. The only code covering both is 8B4Z 'Spinal cord disorders excluding trauma, unspecified', too vague to be useful.
No 'haemolytic anaemia NOS': acquired (3A2Z) and hereditary (3A10.Z, where sickle cell sits) are separate blocks. 3A2Z would assert acquired.

ICD-11 codes HIV by WHO clinical stage and by TB/malaria co-infection (1C60, 1C61, 1C62.0-.3). Advanced HIV spans stages 3 and 4 (or CD4 < 200) with or without TB, so no one code is true. Search's top hit (5A00.0Y, via the acronym AHDS) is unrelated.
Two different WHO categories: lung abscess (CA43.2 / CA43.Z) and pyothorax (CA44). No parent covers both. Could be split into two terms.
No 'megaloblastic anaemia NOS' in ICD-11: B12 (3A01.Z) and folate (3A02.Z) are separate. Search's top hit 3A01.Y rejected.
Pancreas (2C10.Z) and the biliary tract (2C15 distal bile duct, 2C17 other or unspecified parts, among others) are separate categories. Could be split into two terms.
Suicidal ideation is a symptom code (MB26.A); a self-harm act is an external-cause code (PD3Z). No code covers both. Could be split.
Covers tumour lysis, hypercalcaemia of malignancy, SVC obstruction and cord compression, each coded separately. Search's top hit (BE1D, SVC obstruction by a foreign body) is wrong.
